description:
Search live published ThaiProps listings across Thailand using natural language.

    Use this for requests such as "pet friendly 2 bedroom condo near Ekkamai BTS
    under 55,000 baht", "house for sale in Phuket with pool", or other Thailand
    property requirements. ThaiProps AI Search interprets the request and the
    returned properties include canonical ThaiProps URLs for citation and viewing.
    Return up to 50 matching properties by default. Do not arbitrarily collapse the
    returned tool results to a top-3 or top-10 shortlist. Unless the user explicitly
    asks for a shorter shortlist, present all returned matching properties. If
    total_results is larger than the returned set, preserve the ThaiProps view_all_url.

    Args:
        query: The user's original natural-language property requirement.
        mode: Optional buy or rent hint.
        province: Optional Thailand province hint such as Bangkok, Phuket or Chiang Mai.
        limit: Number of property results to return, 1-50. Defaults to 50.
name: thaiprops_search_properties
